notes.title: GO BOBA GO UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello shopkeepers![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191664/f2c3e34affd18cc0d6aa1f16253b75f51230f09f.gif[/img]

I wish you all a great year. This new update brings three big things to the Boba Simulator.
[list]
[*] new delivery service
[*] new game mode
[*] new branch[/list]

[h2]The new delivery service[/h2]
As your Boba Tea business grows,  more customers want to try your delicious tea. But no matter how fast you can make them or how many Bobarista you hire, you cannot satisfy them all when a mob approaches your shop. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191664/bcdfec2e88e39a00a6951681f718de08faa0d37a.gif[/img]

The new delivery service is designed to bridge that gap. You can now deliver your "DIY Boba Tea Kit" to customers who order it through the delivery app. This will help spread your tea and increase your sales [b]without wasting time making it at your storefront[/b]. The whole delivery service will rely on "service points" that come from upgrading the contract with the delivery company. Use those service points to fine-tune the delivery service, i.e., rider amount, delivery range, max cup per round. Each state of the game may need a different mixture of that. Please note that marketing upgrades and marketing staff hiring will directly affect your incoming orders.



[h2]The new Endless Mode[/h2]
The new game mode is now available for endless pleasure and infinite relaxation. You begin with a tiny little Boba Stand, perform your best Boba Tea while growing your business, and upgrade it until it becomes larger and larger...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191664/10e2e4ac92ae1cc9170ed4237c4c15217a92e7fb.gif[/img]

Once your shop gets big enough, You will have access to all-new, limitless features.

[b]BRANDING:[/b] More competitors will enter the market. You need to keep your brand power high with marketing tools or hire marketers to help you.

[b]FOOD SUPPLIER:[/b] Provide ingredients for you during business hours. If your storage is full, you can also make a clearance sale here.

[b]WAREHOUSE:[/b] Allow you to rent more storage by making rental agreements with local warehouses. This will create opportunities for more daily income and maximize your cup sales per day.

[b]SUB-BRANCH:[/b] Open the new sub-branch without going to manage it. The sub-branch will increase your daily income and daily cup sales based on the mother shop’s performance.



[h2]The new BOBA CAFÉ[/h2]

BOBA CAFÉ is a new establishment. It is the first branch that has integrated Delivery Service, and you can use it from the start. People in this area are addicted to sweetness, and you need to adjust your recipe based on that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191664/dec94d175eb9693fffa5fe42016744ce594170ec.gif[/img]


[h2]THE MORE WAYS TO PLAY, THE BETTER.[/h2]

Many shopkeepers love to hire Bobarista and ignore other staff (a marketer and an entertainer). So I rebalanced the game and enabled more ways to play in this update. Now you can hover on "?" in the staff tab to get more information for each role.

Storefront-oriented: This is the current trend in play. Make the tea-making speed upgrade a priority, and hire as many Bobarista as you can. Now you've got lightspeed income.

Delivery-oriented: Focus on and balance the delivery service upgrade with the marketing upgrade, and hire a full team of marketers. This allows you to dominate the delivery market and earn a lot of money even during the day when people want to stay at home due to the "newspaper effect."

Luck-oriented: This is a pure Gacha game. Get the fully upgraded Boballoon with a full team of entertainers. This can bring you a great bonus without caring about customers, recipes, or competitors.

All of the above methods can be mixed together to create your own unique style of play. Just play in whatever way you feel like it. That’s the point of Boba Simulator.




I hope you enjoy the new update, and happy new year to everyone :D

- Napas -

notes.title: New BOBA BAR update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Shop Keepers[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191664/058189208b54b605daa3b4e2267a82fac6a87f0a.gif[/img]

Your new branch the "BOBA BAR" is ready for you to run your Boba business.

The BOBA BAR is the large shop placed in ocean park area.
Because of its size you can hire max staff to help you hear!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191664/c29fe4ab3ada3a3f17774267b037f846848997b7.gif[/img]

More importantly, the ocean park area will often spawn famous "Boballoon".
Basically, just click on all Boballoons that spawn near your shop and you will get the bonus.
Boballoon will spawn randomly in business time. But the good news is you can upgrade it to give more bonus, to chain spawn other Boballoons, or to spawn more frequently.

The full upgrade can provide bonus up to $9,000 per day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191664/992b77204a9a95704e2bee4d80235ace2e67e16b.png[/img]

The new Boba Coin system has been added. You will earn Boba Coin everytime you finish the branch. The Boba Coin may be useful in the future update. Better keep collecting it!

--------------------------------------------------------

More details on this patch note in case you want to know.
- Add the all new BOBA BAR branch.
- Add the new Boballoons system into gameplay.
- The goal has been rework and now support multiple goals in single branch.
- Change Supermarket price scaling. (Less spam the buy button and more benefit)
- Add save game indicator.
- Rework on speed settings (now speed up only in business time).
- Add new Boba Coin system to reward dedicate player in the future.
- Add 2 new Steam Achievements.
- Add feature preview in startup popup.
- Branch selection menu will remember your last play and will automatically jump to the latest unlocked branch when restart the game.
- Improve overall game performance.

Bug fix:
- Fix Likeness sometime show as an integer.
- Fix "Max Upgrade" reward sometime not firing.
- Fix audio settings glitch.
- Fix Supermarket discount bug.

Know issue:
- Sometime when massive customers visit your shop the game will lag. This will fix in future patch.

------------------------------------------------------------------

Please feel free to feedback on this game or share it to streamer you know to support Boba Simulator :D

Thank you so much for all of your support.

- Napas -
